name: dev.skywake/skywake
title: Skywake
description: Disks with branches and indexes searched by meaning and keywords, for agents: files, bash and search in one server.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Skywake API key. Its environment is where the server works.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Skywake API. https://api.skywake.dev by default.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_DISK
environmentVariables.description: The disk the file tools use by default.

environmentVariables.name: SKYWAKE_BRANCH
environmentVariables.description: The branch the file tools write to. Without it, the server forks a branch of its own for the session.
